sentences.text: For the pre-payment charge directions at paragraph 261(1) and 261(2), the source of funds used for pre-payment does not matter, because they apply irrespective of the source of funds used for pre-payment, in part or in full.
Those same directions also apply without any minimum lock-in period.

The specific pre-payment charge treatment for a given loan still depends on which pre-payment-charge paragraph applies to the loan, and the record here says applicability of those paragraphs is unknown without the loan details needed for that determination.
